Specification: This module is a skeletal TLA+ wrapper for model checking a majority-vote setting over bounded sequences drawn from three constant elements A, B, and C. It defines the value set {A, B, C}, a helper operator BoundedSeq(S) that denotes all sequences over S of lengths between 0 and bound, and declares state variables seq, i, cand, and cnt. The file does not define an initial condition, next-state relation, temporal specification, or properties to verify; it appears intended to support or instantiate an external Majority module rather than to contain the full algorithm itself.
